startup_error_message: The app couldn't access its local data. Your recipes aren't lost — this sometimes happens in private browsing, when storage is full, or right after a browser update. Try again, or restart your browser if the problem persists.
storage_write_error: Couldn't save this change (local storage issue). Nothing on your end has been lost, but try again before continuing.
import_url_paste_empty: No address found in the clipboard.
import_url_paste_error: Couldn't read the clipboard (permission denied by the browser). Paste the link manually into the field above.
import_url_error: Couldn't fetch this recipe. The site might not be supported, or the link is incorrect.
import_url_intro_title: Add a recipe you found online in just a few seconds.
import_url_step1: On the recipe website, copy the page address (or, if the app is installed, tap “Share” in your browser and choose My Recipes).
import_url_step2: Paste it below, then tap “Fetch the recipe”.
import_url_step3: Check the result before saving: quantities and units aren't always recognised perfectly.
import_url_compat: Works with most major recipe websites. Pages reserved for subscribers or that require signing in can't be read.
import_url_privacy: 🔒 To read the page, the address you paste goes through an intermediary service (a browser can't read a page from another website directly; several services are tried if needed). Only this address is sent — never your recipes or your data.
import_url_error_offline: Couldn't fetch this recipe: the internet connection seems to be unavailable. Check your connection and try again.
import_url_duplicate_warning: 💡 If an ingredient from the recipe is already in your list under a slightly different name (“yellow onion” / “onion”), it may be added twice. You can fix it in the form before saving.
import_url_failure_warning: The website may not have responded in time. Try again in a few seconds; if it still fails, take a screenshot of the recipe and use “Import from a photo”.
ingredient_duplicates_hint: These ingredient pairs look very similar. Merge them if it's really the same ingredient, or mark it as not a duplicate so it stops showing up.
ingredient_duplicates_merge_hint: The other name will be replaced by this one in all your recipes.
shopping_load_list_confirm: Replace the current shopping list with this one?
qrcode_shopping_hint: Scan from another device using the app, to add these items directly.
qrscan_hint: Point at the QR code of a shopping list or a recipe shared from another device (mobile or desktop).
qrscan_camera_denied: Camera access denied or unavailable. Check the app's permissions in your phone settings.
qrscan_camera_denied_permission: Camera permission is turned off for this app. To enable it: Phone Settings → Apps → (app name) → Permissions → Camera → Allow. In the meantime, you can import an already-taken photo instead.
qrscan_camera_denied_notfound: No camera detected on this device.
qrscan_camera_denied_busy: The camera is being used by another app. Close it, then try again.
qrscan_camera_https_hint: Camera access requires a secure connection (HTTPS) — unavailable until the app is published online.
qrscan_not_recognized: This QR code is neither a shopping list nor a recipe recognized by the app.
qrscan_paste_fallback_link: Scan not working? Paste the QR code content
standalone_timers_intro: One or more independent timers, without needing to open a recipe. Closing this window doesn't stop them — you can navigate elsewhere in the app, the notification will alert you when ready.
qrpaste_hint: Scan the QR code with another app (the camera app, a scanner app...), copy the resulting text, then paste it here.
qrpaste_empty: Paste the QR code text first.
qrscan_no_code_found: No QR code detected in the image. Move the phone closer or farther, or check the lighting.
qrscan_image_load_error: Couldn't read this file as an image — check that it's a valid photo or screenshot.
qrscan_import_confirm: Add these {count} item(s) to the current shopping list?
qrscan_using_native: Native system detection active — point at the QR code.
qrscan_using_jsqr: Standard detection active — point at the QR code.
qrscan_native_fallback: The system's native reader is not available on this device — switching to the backup reader.
qrscan_lib_load_error: Couldn't load the QR code reader. Check your connection and try again.
cookbook_export_hint: Choose the recipes to include, in the order they'll appear.
manage_substitutions_hint: Ingredients with at least one known substitute. Search for any ingredient to add one.
manage_substitutions_none: No ingredient has a saved substitute yet.
whatcancook_hint: Started from your pantry — add or remove ingredients for this check, without changing the pantry itself.
whatcancook_no_ingredients: Add at least one ingredient to see which recipes are feasible.
import_photo_disclaimer_main: Take or choose a photo of a recipe (book, magazine, legible handwritten note). Text recognition happens directly on your phone — nothing is sent to an outside service, but it downloads a file of a few MB the first time,
import_photo_disclaimer_warning: and is never perfect: always check the result before saving.
import_photo_savedata_warning: 📶 Data saver is on for this phone: text recognition will download a language model (a few MB) if it isn't already cached. You can continue, or wait until you're on Wi-Fi.
import_photo_processing: Analyzing text… (may take a minute the first time)
import_photo_error: Couldn't analyze this photo. Try again with a sharper, well-framed, well-lit photo.
import_photo_no_text: No text recognized on this photo.
stats_all_cooked: All your recipes have already been cooked!
import_photo_max_reached: Maximum number of photos reached for this recipe.
import_photo_manual_needed: Not determined — choose the section below
import_photo_crop_hint: Drag the corners to keep only the useful area, then confirm.
import_photo_crop_handle_tl: Top-left corner of the crop frame
import_photo_crop_handle_tr: Top-right corner of the crop frame
import_photo_crop_handle_bl: Bottom-left corner of the crop frame
import_photo_crop_handle_br: Bottom-right corner of the crop frame
import_photo_crop_failed_reverted: The crop analysis failed: the previous result was kept.
import_photo_merge_hint: Combines the text of all analyzed photos into a single recipe, to check afterwards in the form.
stats_empty: Add recipes to see statistics appear.
import_photo_persons_label: Number of servings for this recipe:
import_photo_persons_assumed: not detected — assumed value, please check
qrcode_hint: Scan with another phone to receive the name and ingredients, no link or file needed.
trash_delete_forever_confirm: Permanently delete this recipe? This can't be undone.
qrcode_load_error: Couldn't generate the QR code (library unavailable). Check your connection and try again.
trash_empty_all_confirm: Permanently delete all recipes in the trash?
qrcode_multi_hint: This recipe is too long for a single QR code: it has been split into {total} QR codes to scan one after another, in any order.
qrscan_multi_progress: ✅ Part {current} of {total} scanned. Now scan the next QR code for this recipe.
unitconv_intro: A small tool independent of any recipe, handy for a recipe found elsewhere (e.g. in cups/ounces).
qrscan_multi_already_have: This part has already been scanned.
qrscan_multi_new_batch: ⚠️ This QR belongs to a different recipe — starting over for this new batch.
qrscan_multi_inconsistent: ⚠️ This fragment does not match the current batch (inconsistent part count) — ignored.
qrscan_multi_checksum_failed: ❌ The reassembled content does not match the expected checksum — a part may be damaged. Please scan again.
unitconv_density_warning: ⚠️ This conversion assumes a density close to water: 1 mL ≈ 1 g. The result can be inaccurate for other ingredients, notably flour, oil or honey.
diagnostic_intro: Technical information useful for reporting an issue — contains no recipes, no personal content, and no imported addresses.
diagnostic_report_hint: Describe what happened — the technical information above will be attached automatically.
diagnostic_report_empty: Please describe the problem before reporting it.
diagnostic_report_fallback: The report text was copied — send it for example by email to majogari81@gmail.com, or paste it wherever you prefer.
backup_export_text: Saves all your recipes, shopping lists, pantry and custom ingredients into a single file, to keep them safe or transfer them to another device.
backup_shared_title: Shared backup with the Windows app
backup_shared_text: Format compatible with the desktop application — recipes (with their photos), known ingredients, pantry and customizations. Meal planning, menus and saved shopping lists are not yet included in this format.
backup_import_text: Load a previously exported file. Choose what to do with it below.
backup_import_confirm_replace: This will erase all your current data and replace it with the file's content. Continue?
backup_import_error: This isn't a valid backup file.
backup_import_success_with_safety: Import successful! Your previous data was also downloaded as a precaution before the replacement.
backup_import_large_file_warning: This file is large ({size} MB). Analyzing it may take a moment. Continue?
backup_import_too_large: This file exceeds the {size} MB limit and cannot be imported.
backup_preview_text:
{date}{recipes} recipe(s), {ingredients} ingredient(s), {menus} menu(s), {shopping} shopping list item(s).

Continue with this backup?
backup_share_hint: Opens your phone's share menu: choose your cloud app to send the backup there, outside the browser.
backup_structural_fixes: 🛠️ {count} malformed item(s) fixed or removed (name, rating, category, unit...).
backup_share_fallback_notice: Direct sharing isn't available on this device — the backup was saved to your Downloads folder instead.
backup_android_tip_title: 💡 Keeping a copy in the cloud
backup_android_tip_text: The "Export" button saves the backup only on this device (Downloads folder) — it doesn't automatically appear on your other devices. To send it to Google Drive, OneDrive, or another service and find it elsewhere, use "Share backup" below instead.
backup_android_tip_text_no_share: The "Export" button saves the backup only on this device (Downloads folder) — it doesn't automatically appear on your other devices. Your browser doesn't offer direct sharing here: to send it to Google Drive, OneDrive, or another service, open that Downloads folder and send the file yourself to the app of your choice.
home_empty_restore_hint: Already have a backup? You can restore it.
home_backup_reminder: 💾 It's been a while since you last backed up your data. Tap here to do it in a moment.
home_backup_reminder_urgent: ⚠️ It's been over a month since your last backup. Tap here to do it now.
home_backup_reminder_critical: 🔴 It's been over two months without a backup — your data only exists on this device. Tap here to keep it safe.
substitutes_none: No known substitute for the ingredients in this recipe.
pantry_reduction_fully_covered: {name}: already enough in your pantry, not added
pantry_reduction_reduced: {name}: quantity reduced based on what you already have ({qty} {unit} needed)
compare_select_both: Choose at least two different recipes (A and B) to compare them.
recipe_cost_partial: Partial estimate: {priced} of {total} ingredient(s) have a price (Manage ingredients).
home_wishlist_reminder: 💭 {count} recipe(s) on your wish list for over {days} days — how about trying them? (tap to see them)
compare_estimate_note: Cost for each recipe's default number of servings. * = partial estimate (prices or nutrition values missing for some ingredients).
recipe_filter_ingredients_hint: Separate several ingredients with commas. “chicken” also finds “Chicken breast”.
ingredient_used_in_none: Not used in any recipe yet.
cooklog_comment_placeholder: e.g. a bit too salty, shorten the cooking time
planning_ics_empty: The plan is empty: add at least one recipe before exporting it to a calendar.
planning_ics_done:
Calendar file created ({count} meal(s), for the next 7 days).

Depending on your calendar app, it may open directly on your phone.

Google Calendar can only import it from a computer: open calendar.google.com, then Settings (gear) > Settings > Import & export, select the file and click Import.
import_web_search_label: No recipe yet? Search for one online
import_web_search_hint: Opens a search limited to recipe websites. Pick a recipe, then share its page to the app or copy its address and paste it below.
menu_add_recipe: Add a recipe to the menu
menu_no_recipes: No recipe in this menu yet.
menu_no_menus: You don't have any menu yet.
planning_apply_template_confirm: Replace the current plan with this template?
planning_history_reapply_confirm: Reload this week into the current plan? The currently displayed plan will be replaced.
planning_history_delete_confirm: Delete this week from the history?
ingredient_list_truncated_hint: Showing {shown} of {total} ingredients — type above to search among the rest.
ingredient_nutrition_hint: Values per 100 g or 100 ml. Leave blank if you don't know them.
drag_handle_label: Drag to reorder, or use the up/down arrow keys
no_recipes_yet:
You don't have any recipe yet.
Start by adding one!
pdf_include_photo_confirm: Include this recipe's photo in the PDF?
form_allergens_hint: Based on the ingredients entered above. Always check packaging yourself: this is only indicative.
ingredient_price_hint: Optional. Leave blank if you don't know it.
ingredient_substitutes_hint: Your own suggestions, in addition to any already known for this ingredient.
form_ingredients_hint: Enter quantities for 1 person: the app recalculates them automatically based on the number of servings.
form_import_quantity_reminder: 💡 The quantities below were recalculated for 1 person from the imported recipe (originally meant for {persons} people) — this is normal, they will be multiplied back automatically when displayed.
ingredient_uncertain_tooltip: Uncertain recognition (photo import) — please check this line.
form_draft_found_confirm: An unfinished recipe was found: "{name}". Pick up where you left off?
pantry_threshold_hint: A reminder will appear on the home screen once the quantity drops below this (leave empty to never be alerted).
pantry_add_quantity_hint: Current stock: {quantity} {unit} — enter here how many you just added (this amount will be added to the existing stock).
pantry_expiration_hint: A reminder will appear on the home screen once the date is near or past (leave empty to never be alerted).
pantry_expiration_photo_found: Date detected: {date} — please check before saving.
pantry_expiration_photo_not_found: No date recognized in this photo. Try a clearer shot, or enter it manually.
pantry_expiration_invalid: This date doesn't exist (invalid day or month).
home_low_stock_reminder: 📦 {count} ingredient(s) almost out in your pantry: {names} — tap to add them to the shopping list
home_expiring_reminder: ⏰ {count} pantry item(s) expiring soon or already expired: {names} — tap to view them
barcode_scan_hint: Point at the product's barcode. The name found will need confirming — it's never applied automatically.
barcode_native_unavailable: Barcode scanning via camera isn't supported by this browser. Use manual entry below.
barcode_manual_hint: Type the barcode's digits, shown under the black bars.
barcode_manual_invalid: This barcode looks incomplete (at least 8 digits expected).
barcode_manual_checksum_invalid: This barcode doesn't look valid (check for a typo).
barcode_net_quantity_hint: Net weight/volume from the product listing (for reference only): {quantity}
barcode_product_not_found: Product not found automatically — check/fill in the name yourself.
barcode_lookup_network_error: Could not check this product online (no connection or server unreachable) — fill in the name yourself.
barcode_photo_not_found: No barcode recognized in this photo. Try a sharper image, or enter the barcode manually.
recipeform_duplicate_ingredient_message:
« {list} » appears more than once in this recipe.

Keep as is, or merge (quantities added together)?
shopping_empty:
Your shopping list is empty.
Add recipes from their page.
pantry_reservations_hint: Keeps you from re-buying what you already have: when a recipe is added to the shopping list, the quantity already here is set aside instead of being asked for again.
pantry_reservation_from_shopping_deleted: for an already deleted shopping item
pantry_reservations_reset_confirm: Reset all pantry reservations? Future additions to the shopping list will again consider the full stock as available.
cooking_wake_lock_unavailable: The screen may turn off automatically (feature unavailable on this device or refused by power saving).
cooking_notification_body: Your cooking timer has reached zero.
cooking_notification_permission_denied: Notifications are blocked in your browser settings — the timer will still ring and vibrate normally within the app.
install_prompt_text: Add this app to your home screen to open it like a real app.
install_ios_instructions: On iPhone/iPad, installation is done through the browser: tap the Share icon 􀈂 at the bottom of the screen (Safari), then "Add to Home Screen".
install_already_installed: The app is already installed on this device.
